name: Elixir RSS reader with read-later collections

mentions.name: Elixir RSS reader with read-later collections
mentions.description: An Elixir app that lets an administrator add new RSS feeds, renders article titles and summaries on a single page to scroll through, and pushes the ones they like to a landing page as a collection to read later. The parser is modified and adapted to handle sites that deviate from the conventional RSS structure.
mentions.problem: Many of the sites the builder likes don't have the conventional RSS "structure", so the main parser has to be modified and adapted to the outliers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been using elixir to build an app that lets an administrator add new rss feeds, render the article titles and summaries to a single page, scroll through them and push the ones they like to a landing page as a collection to read later.
